name: com.ambiguous-interactive.signalfish
description: C# client SDK for the Signal Fish multiplayer signaling server: rooms, lobbies, readiness, relay, heartbeats, reconnection, spectators, authority, and v3 mesh signaling. Zero dependencies, Unity compatible (netstandard2.1).

samples.description: A MonoBehaviour that connects, joins a room, and polls and dispatches client events in Update().
